analysis_plan.fold_assignment: source-defined template binding strata, outcome-independent hash ordering
analysis_plan.selection: minimum pooled inner-OOF Brier; ties use first declared l2; refit outer training only

ensemble_method: mean of the fixed seeded OOF probabilities per target, never label-weighted

feature_manifest.limitation: Exploratory nested grouped prediction on already-consumed discovery targets; not mechanism C or unfamiliar-program/final confirmation. All eighteen existing source, neutral, oracle, next-token confidence and finite-event alternative tiers are retained unchanged. Five fixed joint tiers combine the four existing BF16 next-token scalars and six existing FP32/no-TF32 finite numeral-plus-EOS scalars in each declared context. Those tiers are feature-nested in both corresponding confidence alternatives. No new language-model query is performed; scientific access remains the union of the two measurement contracts: one BF16 next-token prefill plus one FP32 event prefix prefill and 33 numerals with the declared EOS union across 35 prefix states. Saved caches do not remove that scientific cost. A predictive increment can reflect encoding, fitted function class and numerical execution, rather than a pure information or causal mechanism effect. Finite-event support excludes other textual answers and is not task-correctness probability. Source-oracle, raw-neutral and oracle-scored neutral access stay separately declared. No candidate/token identity, generated answer, target response or correctness is a feature; correctness is only the existing supervised label. Repeated partition seeds reuse the same structural groups. Bootstrap intervals condition on saved OOF probabilities without refitting or multiplicity adjustment.
feature_manifest.parent_confidence_measurement_backend: Transformers BF16 exact saved prompt prefill distributions; no generation

parent_scientific_access_cost.neutral_and_oracle_access: unchanged and separately declared per tier
